description.text: Teaching Objective To cultivate senior applied Stomatology talents with strong hands-on skills, entrepreneurial ability, and strong ability to develop. To cultivate Doctors for diagnosis and treatment of stomatological disease. Graduates acquire following knowledge and ability 1.Basic theoretical knowledge and experimental skills of preclinical medicine and clinical medicine 2.Basic theoretical knowledge and clinical operational skills of various disciplines of Stomatology; 3.Dentistry common disease diagnosis, treatment and initial processing of urgent, difficult, severe symptom; 4.A basic knowledge of dental work and general skills; 5.Mastering medical literature search, the basic method of data survey, with initial capacity of oral medical research.Main coursesBiochemistry, Physiology, Medical Immunology, medical microbiology, Experiment of medical functional science, Pathology, pharmacology, clinical diagnostics, oral anatomical physiology, oral histology and pathology, internal medicine, surgery, Cariology And Endodontics, Periodontics, oral mucosal disease study, oral and maxillofacial surgery, prosthodontics, orthodontics, prevention of oral medicine.Degree AwardedBachelor of Medicine

duration.text: The Stomatology at Zhengzhou University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 6944 USD/per year ￥ 50000 CNY/per year

materials.text: "*" means necessary documents that you must provide in your application.If you want to book our translation service, please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents;If you want to book our guardian service, you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents in time.*1. Full CV*2. Working Certificates of all posts*3. The list of publications and the soft copy of master thesis and best publications.*4. Passport (should be valid at less one more year)5. Passport photoA recent passport-sized photo of the applicant*6. The notarized degree certificates of all tertiary studies (bachelor and Master)Certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required.For current student, the certificate of current study, and the master degree certificate should be obtain before registration, otherwise the offer will be not valid.*7. Transcripts of all tertiary studies (bachelor and Master)Transcript in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization.*8. Non-criminal Record Certificate (Generally, it is valid for 3 months)It must be issued by your local police station with official stamp.*9. The Valid Report of English Language Proficiency TestsIf you do not have IELTS or TOEFL, please provide an official certificate issued by your university which should certify that the medium of instruction in your university is English*10. Two academic referee lettersYou should invite two academics who are familiar with your academic achievements to write recommendation letters. They should be signed recently with contact email and phone number.*11. Physical Examination Record with issuing dateIt is valid only in 6 months. Please make sure it is still valid when you apply for visa.You can download a template or sample from here.12. Other documents, documentary evidence of academic awards and professional qualifications, and summary of relevant experience.*13. The statement of research interest and research proposalIn general, a statement of research interest should include reasons for undertaking this study at ZZU and future career prospect, while a research proposal should include the background, the objectives and the methodology or approach you propose to take in studying the subject matter. The minimum word limit for the proposal is 2000. Proper referencing is needed in the preparation of research proposals. Applicants are strongly suggested to contact their potential supervisor to discuss the research proposal before submission. The result of the plagiarism check will be taken into consideration when the Department, Faculty and Graduate School review the application. The application may be deemed unsuccessful if plagiarized materials are identified.14. Supporting Documents: Certificate of Good ConductProvided by your current/previous school/company in Chinese/English to improve your success rate.You can download a template or sample from here.Tips:For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.

requirements.text: 1. Applicant should be non-Chinese citizen, healthy, without any crime records, aged less than 40 years old; with excellent academic record of master, and potentially to be a highly specialized researcher, engineer or professional; rich in publication. 2. English language requirements: for candidates from non-English spoken countries applying for EMI (English Mediated Instruction) programs, their minimum IELTS score should reach 6.5 or TOEFL score reach 90(IBT) or equivalent. 3. Specific requirements for individual academic schools maybe imposed by the board and subjects taken. You are advised to check with your prospective school or supervisor. 4. For Research Degree Programs Since the postgraduate research degrees are individually supervised. We strongly recommend that prospective applicants make initial enquiries with the potential supervisor or school before submitting a formal application. A research proposal is required along with your formal application.
